summary: Website project with admin panel featuring Internet Identity authentication. Work includes UI fixes, removing elements, and fixing admin dashboard to show Internet Identity login button.
architectural_notes: Admin panel uses two-layer auth: password login first, then Internet Identity for sensitive data access
Internet Identity authentication is required for managing services, users, and mechanics in admin panel
known_issues: Admin Dashboard missing Internet Identity login button — users cannot authenticate to load Users/Services/Mechanics data

existing_features.title: Remove the anchor element and its child SVG icon identified by XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[3]/a[1] and /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/div[3]/a[1]/svg[1] from the Header component. These are located in the third div group of the header's first div, and both the link wrapper and the SVG inside it must be completely removed.

Remove the 'Call Now' button or link from the Header component (frontend/src/components/Header.tsx). This is the element labeled 'Call Now' visible in the top/header area of the page. It must be completely removed from the header markup.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add Internet Identity login button to Admin Dashboard so users can authenticate and access Users/Services/Mechanics data
Remove two selected elements (link and SVG icon) and remove 'Call Now' button/link from header
